description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao class, which handles database operations related to employee US tax exemptions within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving and retrieving tax exemption entities and extends a base DAO class.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for employee US tax exemption entities, providing methods to save and retrieve tax exemption data.

methods.name: saveEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Persists an EmpUsTaxExemption entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpUsTaxExemption entity based on the employee number.
